free_tier.stated: 1 GB of attachment storage per base on the Free plan
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: Individual attachments can be up to 5 GB; on the Free plan the per-base allowance caps a single attachment at 1 GB.
per_object_cap.notes: On the Free plan a single attachment is capped at 1 GB by the 1 GB per-base attachment allowance; the direct file-bytes upload API accepts at most 5 MB.

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: The Free plan includes 2 weeks of revision and snapshot history; Airtable states it never removes data when record or attachment limits are reached.

egress.terms: Free; attachments served from airtableusercontent.com (CloudFront-fronted) with expiring signed URLs

tooling: Official Web API v0: POST /v0/{baseId}/{recordId}/{attachmentFieldId}/uploadAttachment accepts raw bytes up to 5 MB, larger files go via the content.airtable.com upload-then-attach flow
chaining: 1 GB x 1,500 bases x N workspaces = ~1.5 TB per free workspace as documented, multiplied by unlimited free workspaces. Pricing config also states 'unlimited bases' on Free; the 1,500 figure is the per-workspace cap. This is the single largest documented multiplicative figure in this area.
